cases.name: quoted identifier case
cases.declared: CREATE TABLE "Values" ("Id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MiXeD');
cases.actual: create table [values] (id integer primary key, text text not null default 'MiXeD')

cases.name: literal case is significant
cases.declared: CREATE TABLE values_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, text TEXT DEFAULT 'MiXeD');
cases.actual: CREATE TABLE values_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, text TEXT DEFAULT 'mixed');

cases.name: quoted apostrophe and comments
cases.declared: /* declaration */ CREATE TABLE [data] (id INTEGER, label TEXT DEFAULT 'it''s', PRIMARY KEY (id ASC));
cases.actual: CREATE TABLE `data` (`id` INTEGER, label TEXT DEFAULT 'it''s', PRIMARY KEY (`id` ASC)); -- tail

cases.name: constraint mismatch
cases.declared: CREATE TABLE data (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value REAL NOT NULL);
cases.actual: CREATE TABLE data (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value REAL);
